Short of a length outside off, there for the cut but Ravindra edges it behind. He closes his eyes as he walks off. Akash Deep has a smile on his face as luck finally runs out for Ravindra. Maybe a bit of extra bounce proved to be Ravindra's undoing. Rachin Ravindra c Rishabh Pant b Akash Deep 15(50) [4s-2] 18.1 Prasidh Krishna to Rachin Ravindra, 1 run, out with a direct-hit from Kamboj at mid-off. Prasidh Krishna shifts to over the wicket and bowls this full outside off, driven to the right of Kamboj who picks it up with one hand. Goes at the bowler's end and misses. Ravindra sliding the bat in 16.6 Prasidh Krishna to Rachin Ravindra, no run, good stop by Kamboj at mid-off. He gets across and cuts it off with a dive to his left. Full outside off, Rachin Ravindra gets forward and punched the off-drive with timing 16.3 Prasidh Krishna to Rachin Ravindra, 1 run, full and angled in on off, Rachin Ravindra gets forward to drive wide of Bumrah to his left, at mid-on 16.2 Prasidh Krishna to Rachin Ravindra, no run, short of length on the fifth-stump line, angled in, Rachin Ravindra goes on the back foot to defend to mid-on 16.1 Prasidh Krishna to Rachin Ravindra, no run, wide of the crease and fullish outside off, angles in, not enough to make Rachin Ravindra have a dabble 15.6 Akash Deep to Rachin Ravindra, 3 runs, short of length outside off, Rachin Ravindra stays besides the line and punches wide of backward point. It's chased down with a slide and one saved as they come back for three 15.5 Akash Deep to Rachin Ravindra, no run, fullish outside off, in the corridor of uncertainty, holds its line, left alone 15.4 Akash Deep to Rachin Ravindra, no run, full outside off, Rachin Ravindra gets forward to defend to backward point 15.3 Akash Deep to Rachin Ravindra, no run, full outside off, moves away, Rachin Ravindra gets forward and has a good look before he leaves 15.2 Akash Deep to Rachin Ravindra, no run, short of length outside off, Rachin Ravindra goes on the back foot and cuts to backward point 15.1 Akash Deep to Rachin Ravindra, no run, beaten! Angle in on a short of length to the fifth-stump line, then it moves away to beat the defence of Rachin Ravindra. That is well bowled 14.4 Prasidh Krishna to Rachin Ravindra, 1 run, short of length on off, Rachin Ravindra goes on the back foot and closes the face of the bat to nudge it behind square on the leg-side for one 14.3 4 Prasidh Krishna to Rachin Ravindra, FOUR , Prasidh Krishna goes full outside off and Rachin Ravindra gets forward to reach for it, drives and beats mid-off to his left. On the up and even though it's not timed, it's in the gap 14.2 Prasidh Krishna to Rachin Ravindra, no run, wide of the crease and good length outside off, bit of bounce, Rachin Ravindra lets it go 14.1 Prasidh Krishna to Rachin Ravindra, no run, starts from round the wicket and it's well wide of off, good length, left alone 12.6 Anshul Kamboj to Rachin Ravindra, no run, wide of the crease and angled in on off, good length and Rachin Ravindra gets forward to defend to mid-off 12.5 Anshul Kamboj to Rachin Ravindra, no run, full outside off, hint of seam movement back in, good leave 12.4 Anshul Kamboj to Rachin Ravindra, no run, short outside off, Rachin Ravindra bails out of the pull at the last moment 12.3 Anshul Kamboj to Rachin Ravindra, no run, full outside off, Rachin Ravindra gets forward to defend solidly to mid-off 12.2 Anshul Kamboj to Rachin Ravindra, no run, fullish and angled in on off, Rachin Ravindra gets forward to defend it back 12.1 Anshul Kamboj to Rachin Ravindra, no run, full and angled in on off, Rachin Ravindra gets forward to defend to backward point 10.6 Anshul Kamboj to Rachin Ravindra, no run, full outside off, Rachin Ravindra gets forward to defend to the left of backward point. Reverses his decision and sends Henry Nicholls back for the quick single 10.5 Anshul Kamboj to Rachin Ravindra, no run, India interested in a caught behind appeal as someone says "thoda si aawaz aaya" [there was a slight noise] but they don't review it. And what do we have here - there's a murmur when ball is next to bat on Sonic. Length delivery outside off, angled in, Rachin Ravindra spars at it and he outside-edges it. Lucky to be there as India get together and despite Rishabh Pant telling if there was a sound it was off the bat, they don't review and had they done so, Ravindra was gone 10.4 Anshul Kamboj to Rachin Ravindra, no run, short of length and angled in on the thigh pad, Rachin Ravindra flicks and misses. Easily missing leg-stump 10.3 Anshul Kamboj to Rachin Ravindra, no run, fullish outside off, angled in, Rachin Ravindra gets forward and shoulders arms 10.2 Anshul Kamboj to Rachin Ravindra, no run, wide of the crease and full and angled in on off, Rachin Ravindra gets forward to defend, the thick outside edge goes down and Jurel dives to his left at gully to cut it off 9.6 Akash Deep to Rachin Ravindra, no run, wide good length delivery outside off, Rachin Ravindra lets it go 9.5 Akash Deep to Rachin Ravindra, no run, short of length outside off, left alone 8.6 Jasprit Bumrah to Rachin Ravindra, no run, short of length outside off, a tempter, Rachin Ravindra gets forward and shoulders arms 8.5 Jasprit Bumrah to Rachin Ravindra, no run, short of length and nips back in to off, Rachin Ravindra gets forward to defend, the thick inside edge hits the pad and rolls near his feet. Wants to pick it up and checks with Jasprit Bumrah who does instead 8.4 Jasprit Bumrah to Rachin Ravindra, no run, thick inside edge and Rachin Ravindra is lucky. Full and very wide outside off, he gets forward to drive and reaches for it, the thick inside edge misses the stumps 8.3 Jasprit Bumrah to Rachin Ravindra, no run, full on off, angled in, Rachin Ravindra gets forward to defend, hits the thick inner half and rolls to mid-wicket 8.2 Jasprit Bumrah to Rachin Ravindra, no run, thick outside edge and Dhruv Jurel dives to his right to stop at gully. Full on off, angled in, Rachin Ravindra gets forward to defend and edge goes down 8.1 Jasprit Bumrah to Rachin Ravindra, no run, full on off, Rachin Ravindra gets forward to defend solidly to mid-off 6.6 Jasprit Bumrah to Rachin Ravindra, no run, short of length outside off, moves away, this time Rachin Ravindra lets it go 6.5 Jasprit Bumrah to Rachin Ravindra, no run, full on middle and off, Rachin Ravindra gets forward to defend to cover 6.4 Jasprit Bumrah to Rachin Ravindra, no run, what a fine short delivery. 141kph and wickedly swerves at Rachin Ravindra who plays it so well. Arches his back and then sways away to leave 6.3 Jasprit Bumrah to Rachin Ravindra, no run, fullish and angled in on middle and off, Rachin Ravindra gets right behind the line as he gets forward to defend it back 6.2 Jasprit Bumrah to Rachin Ravindra, no run, that testing line and length again. Fullish on the 5th-stump line, rising and beating Rachin Ravindra on the forward defence. The ball angled in and just about moved away 6.1 4 Jasprit Bumrah to Rachin Ravindra, FOUR , rare loose delivery and put away. Length delivery and sliding down leg, Rachin Ravindra gets forward and flicks it behind square on the leg-side and it races away to the deep backward square-leg fence 4.6 Jasprit Bumrah to Rachin Ravindra, no run, full and angled in on off, a solid forward defence back 4.5 Jasprit Bumrah to Rachin Ravindra, no run, full and further wide of off, moves away, left alone 4.4 Jasprit Bumrah to Rachin Ravindra, no run, beaten again. Similar delivery to the last one, just that this angles in and then seams away. Rachin Ravindra is covering for the inward movement, so plays at that and the movement beats the outside edge 4.3 Jasprit Bumrah to Rachin Ravindra, no run, beaten! Jasprit Bumrah goes wide of the crease and angles this on the 5th-stump line, full and holds its line, Rachin Ravindra is beaten on the forward defence. Gill with a smile on his face as he claps in encouragement 4.2 Jasprit Bumrah to Rachin Ravindra, no run, full and in the 5th-stump line, holds its line, Rachin Ravindra is sucked into the forward defence and is beaten. Could've and should've left that alone 4.1 Jasprit Bumrah to Rachin Ravindra, no run, fullish on middle, angled in, Rachin Ravindra gets forward to flick to mid-on 3.5 Anshul Kamboj to Rachin Ravindra, 1 run, full and angled in on off, Rachin Ravindra with a solid forward defence to the vacant cover-point area.
